item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hello! I’m Rohan Shrestha 👋

I am a Full Stack Engineer with a passion for designing, developing, and deploying robust, scalable, and beautifully crafted web applications. I bridge the gap between complex backend architectures and high-performance, responsive frontends.

Technical Skillset

Here is a look at the technologies, frameworks, and tools I work with:

Domain Technologies & Tools
Frontend React, Next.js, TailwindCSS
Backend Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs
Databases PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL

Let’s Build Something Together!

I’m always open to discussing interesting projects, open-source collaborations, or engineering opportunities. Feel free to connect with me via GitHub or LinkedIn!

item.title: Why I Built My Developer Portfolio with Hugo and PaperMod
item.description:
As a Full Stack Engineer, my daily work frequently revolves around modern JavaScript frameworks like Next.js, Node.js, and massive containerized services. When it came to building my personal developer portfolio, however, I deliberately took a step back and chose Hugo with the PaperMod theme.

In this article, I want to explore why static site generators (SSGs) remain the gold standard for developer portfolios and how PaperMod combines robust features with lightweight efficiency.
